notes.title: Rabbit Hole game release
notes.notes:
Dear friends. We are pleased to inform you that the Rabbit Hole game was released today. Now it is available on Steam. We thank those who supported us all this time and gave advice to improve the game. In the future, we plan to support the project and make updates to it. We'd love to hear your feedback and suggestions. It is very important to us. It helps us make games better. With love for games Blaze Games.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1488810/Rabbit_Hole/?beta=0]Rabbit Hole Game[/url]

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35375698/f5d70f0ed97a3aa59cb2efdd4e879f1dd380949b.png[/img]

Dear friends.
We are pleased to announce that the development of the game Rabbit Hole has already been completed.
It remains to settle small nuances with the preparation of the release and you will be able to pass it.
We have done a lot of work and hope you enjoy the game.

The game will be released on 10th of September 2022.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1488810/Rabbit_Hole/?beta=0]Rabbit Hole[/url]

notes.title: Demo version of Rabbit Hole now available on Steam
notes.notes:
Play the Rabbit Hole demo at the Steam Festival. Since this is a beta demo, it will be removed and unavailable after the end of the festival. Friends, you have a great opportunity to play and share your fitbacks with us.
Also, do not forget to add the game to your wishlist. Early Access is scheduled for August-September 2021, with a release in December 2021.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1488810/Rabbit_Hole/?beta=0]RABBIT HOLE STEAM[/url]

notes.title: Update 2.2
notes.notes:
Description of changes:

-Added Y-axis mouse inversion.
-Added new effects to improve graphics.
-Improved optimization.
-Improved animations.
-Added new screamers.
-Fixed minor bugs.
